tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who the API key belongs to: the iHatePosting login (email and account name). Use this for any question about who the user is or which account is connected. This is NOT a social media handle — the handles from list_accounts belong to the connected profiles, which may carry other people's names.

tools.name: get_platform_rules
tools.description: What each platform will and will not accept: character limit, whether media is required, how many images, video formats and length, and which per-platform options are MANDATORY (e.g. Pinterest needs a board, YouTube needs a title). tools.name: validate_post
tools.description: Check a post against every platform you plan to send it to, WITHOUT creating anything. Runs the same checks the publisher runs seconds before it posts, so the answer is what will really happen — 'X counts this as 1200/280 characters', 'YouTube needs a title', 'TikTok slideshows take JPEG or WebP pho

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a social post on iHatePosting. action 'draft' saves it (the default, and the safe choice); 'schedule' needs scheduledDate (YYYY-MM-DD) + scheduledTime (e.g. '9:00 AM', in the account owner's timezone); 'now' publishes immediately to a real audience. tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List the 50 most recent iHatePosting posts with per-platform status (draft/scheduled/published/failed) and live URLs.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the connected social accounts (platform, handle, health) available for posting. The response also names the iHatePosting account the API key belongs to — if the accounts listed are not the ones you expect, check that `account.email` is the right person before assuming anything is missing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_platform_rules, validate_post, create_post, list_posts, list_accounts · Private data: whoami, list_accounts · Public sink: whoami, get_platform_rules, validate_post, create_post, list_accounts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_platform_rules, validate_post, create_post, list_posts, list_accounts · Private data: whoami, list_accounts · Public sink: whoami, get_platform_rules, validate_post, create_post, list_accounts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
